acu_definition: 1 ACU = 1 g CO2e net avoided versus the configured cloud baseline. ACU is an internal GreenByte accounting unit, not a carbon credit or financial token.

demo-calibrated-reference.label: Demo calibrated cloud profile — replace coefficients with your benchmark before final judging

local.note: 43 gCO2e/kWh is included only as a lifecycle-style solar demo factor. Replace it with your selected accounting boundary and documented source.

verification.note: Set a measured or allocated verification footprint when you benchmark the final GreenByte Chain.
